audit.why: Sejuani 44.76% over 105 games; Olaf out-duels her every stage until she is a teamfight anchor. Level chart (Olaf 6/7, Skill at 2+) matches the sub-45% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text credits armour stacking to 'passive Permafrost stacks' and to 'Permafrost passive'. Permafrost is Sejuani's E (a stun); the resistances come from Fury of the North's Frost Armor.
audit.why: Two abilities conflated, so the player is told to expect armour from a 1.5s-cooldown stun.
audit.corrected: Attribute armour/MR to Fury of the North (Frost Armor) and keep Permafrost as the E stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: 1) whys[1] names 'Vicious Strikes' — Olaf's W is Tough It Out (attack speed + shield); the lifesteal lives on his passive Berserker Rage. 2) Nothing anywhere states that Fury of the North's Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, which is the decisive answer to Undertow's slow-kite. 3) Tough It Out's shield eating Sejuani's opening damage is never mentioned. 4) mid asserts Ragnarok 'lasts 3 seconds at rank 1 and up to 6 at rank 3' — not stated in Riot's data and unverifiable here.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name, a missing kit-level immunity that flips the level-1 read, an unmentioned shield, and an unverifiable duration.
audit.corrected: Use Berserker Rage for the attack-speed/lifesteal scaling; state Frost Armor's slow immunity vs Undertow; state Tough It Out's shield (16/15/14/13/12s) must be broken before committing Permafrost; replace the duration claim with Ragnarok's verified 100/90/80s cooldown and Riot's own wording that the disable immunity holds while he keeps attacking.

audit.why: Point 6 needs the punishable window named in seconds.
audit.corrected: Undertow 9s (instant on axe pickup), Reckless Swing 11s at rank 1, Ragnarok 100s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frost Armor slow-immunity vs Undertow absent.
audit.why: It is the single mechanic that decides whether Olaf can run you down before he breaks the armour.

edits.before: Olaf throws Undertow at level 1 and picks up the axe instantly to reset it — his level-1 slow-kite pressure is immediate and costs you HP before you have a single ability.
edits.after: Olaf throws Undertow at level 1 and picks the axe up to reset it, but Frost Armor makes you immune to that slow until he breaks it — he cannot kite a full-HP Sejuani.

edits.before: Olaf's first Stridebreaker or Black Cleaver gives him enough run-down power and armor shred to out-trade you through your passive Permafrost stacks, since his true damage on Reckless Swing ignores your resistances entirely.
edits.after: Olaf's first Stridebreaker or Black Cleaver gives him the run-down power and shred to out-trade you through Frost Armor, since Reckless Swing's true damage ignores resistances and refunds its own health cost when it lands the kill.

edits.before: Undertow's axe reset is already cycling every few seconds and Vicious Strikes gives him lifesteal on autos — any trade at level 2 drains you faster than your passive resistances can absorb.
edits.after: Undertow's axe reset cycles every few seconds and Berserker Rage gives him attack speed and lifesteal that grow as he drops — any level-2 trade drains you faster than Frost Armor can absorb it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a dead zone — your damage does not scale with levels the way his does, and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores the armor you are stacking from Permafrost passive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a dead zone — your damage does not scale with levels the way his does, and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores the armour Fury of the North gives you, every 11 seconds.

edits.before: Survive to first item and make him pay for every Undertow with safe wave management behind minions
edits.after: Break Tough It Out's shield with one W arc, then start the real chain while its 16s cooldown burns

edits.before: The moment Olaf reaches level 6 and presses Ragnarok, Arctic Assault's knockup and Permafrost's stun both stop working on him — he is simply immune to your entire kit's CC component while it is active. Do not Q into a Ragnarok Olaf; you will get run down by a CC-immune bruiser dealing true damage with Reckless Swing that bypasses your passive armor stacking. Instead, when you see Ragnarok activate, immediately use Arctic Assault as a gap-closer to escape, not to engage. Farm safely between his R windows, and if your jungler arrives, wait for Ragnarok to expire before committing to the CC chain. His R lasts 3 seconds at rank 1 and up to 6 at rank 3 — count it out loud.
edits.after: The moment Olaf presses Ragnarok his disable immunity holds while he keeps attacking, so Arctic Assault's knockup and Permafrost's stun do nothing to him — never Q into an active R. Treat the activation as your cue to Q away rather than in, and farm the window out: Ragnarok is 100 seconds at rank 1, the longest gap in his kit, and every fight you want lives inside it. Tough It Out is the same problem in miniature, a shield on 16 seconds at rank 1 that swallows your opening damage, so spend a W arc breaking it before you spend Permafrost. If your jungler arrives while Ragnarok is up, hold the chain until it drops — a stun thrown at an immune Olaf costs you the Q you cannot get back.

edits.before: - Olaf Undertow (Axe): matchup-defining — Axe slows let him reach you — stand on the pickup spot to deny resets. Check it before every step-up. - Q dash is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Olaf Undertow: 9s, but reset instantly if he walks over the axe — Frost Armor ignores the slow until he breaks it. - Reckless Swing: 11s at rank 1, true damage, his actual threat. - Ragnarok: 100s at rank 1 — that gap is when you fight.

notes: whys[1] contained the fabricated ability name 'Vicious Strikes' for Olaf's W (real name Tough It Out) and attached lifesteal to it; lifesteal is on the passive Berserker Rage. Two places attributed Sejuani's resistances to 'Permafrost passive' — that is Fury of the North. LEFT ALONE and recorded as unverified: the existing mid-text claim that Ragnarok 'lasts 3 seconds at rank 1 and up to 6 at rank 3' (removed from the rewrite rather than corrected, since Riot's data does not carry the duration). Undertow carries a 'grounding' derived flag that Riot's description does not support (it lists armour and move-speed reduction only) — not asserted anywhere.
